 SCPT.SCTX "Begin PC_m1_MudaliusHorvall_sc

; This script is used for Mudalius during the Stroke of Fortune quest in Anvil

short PC_Map
short T_Local_NoLore
short control
short controlQ
short NoLore
short T_Local_NPC
short isDead
short doonce
short tempStakes

; START Local variables for nine-holes NPC scripting
short T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState ; 0:not in game, 1:assigned to ongoing game
short T_Local_PlayNineholesGold ; Keeps track of the gold NPC has
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ; A (hopefully) unique ID of this NPC used to track if a game against them is played
short lastTurn ; hold the previous value of T_Glob_NineholesGameState
short wager ; Used for money counting when adding/removing it.
short changelevel ; Initial gold value the NPC starts with, used for replenishing from time to time
short localDaysPassed ; DaysPassed storage, used for replenishing from time to time
; END Local variables for nine-holes NPC scripting

; START Main logic code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting
; -- Keep track of NPC's gold
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold != ( GetItemCount gold_001 ) )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
endif

; -- Replenish gold after a week if it went below initial level
if ( changelevel > 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold < changelevel )
		if ( ( localDaysPassed + 7 ) <= DaysPassed ) ; At least a week passed
			set wager to ( changelevel - T_Local_PlayNineholesGold )
			while ( wager >= 10 )
				AddItem ""Gold_001"" 10
				set wager to ( wager - 10 )
			endwhile
			while ( wager >= 1 )
				AddItem ""Gold_001"" 1
				set wager to ( wager - 1 )
			endwhile
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
			set localDaysPassed to DaysPassed
		endif
	endif
endif

; -- Track the game state and react to it
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId != 0 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId == T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ) ; The game now belongs to this NPC
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState to 1
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	endif
elseif ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId != T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ) ; The game doesn't belong to this NPC anymore
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState to 0
		Return
	endif
	if ( lastTurn != 20 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 ) ; New game started for this NPC
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; NPC takes player's bet on game start
				set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet )
				while ( wager >= 10 )
					AddItem ""Gold_001"" 10
					set wager to ( wager - 10 )
				endwhile
				while ( wager >= 1 )
					AddItem ""Gold_001"" 1
					set wager to ( wager - 1 )
				endwhile
			endif
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	elseif ( lastTurn == 20 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 30 ) ; Player won
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; NPC loses their bet + the player's part
				set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet )
				while ( wager >= 10 )
					RemoveItem ""Gold_001"" 20
					set wager to ( wager - 10 )
				endwhile
				while ( wager >= 1 )
					RemoveItem ""Gold_001"" 2
					set wager to ( wager - 1 )
				endwhile
			endif
		endif
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState != lastTurn )
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	endif
endif

; -- Reset the game if NPC can't play it anymore
if ( OnDeath )
    if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
        set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123 ; Reset all game on death
        set lastTurn to 0
    endif
	 set isDead to 1
endif
if ( GetDisabled )
    if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
        set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123 ; Reset all game on disable
        set lastTurn to 0
    endif
endif
; END Main logic code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting

; START DoOnce variable settings code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting
if ( doonce == 0 )
	; Assign a unique id to this player
	set T_Glob_NineholesNpcId to ( T_Glob_NineholesNpcId + 1 )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId to T_Glob_NineholesNpcId

	; also set few initial values
	set changelevel to T_Local_PlayNineholesGold
	set localDaysPassed to DaysPassed

	; assign NPC stakes preferences (low, medium, and/or high)
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 1
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 1
	
	if ( changelevel > 360 )
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 3
		if ( changelevel > 500 )
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 3
		elseif ( changelevel > 420 )
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 2
		endif
	elseif ( changelevel > 120 )
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 2
		if ( changelevel > 150 )
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 2
		endif
	endif

	set doonce to 1
endif
; END DoOnce variable settings code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting

; This script is used for the Stroke of Fortune quest
if ( GetJournalIndex PC_m1_Anv_StrokeFort >= 10 ) 
	if ( GetJournalIndex PC_m1_Anv_StrokeFort < 30 ) 
		if ( GetJournalIndex PC_m1_Anv_StrokeFort == 20 )
			if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes != 0 ) 
				set tempStakes to T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes ; saves assigned stakes for later
				set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 0 ; quest stakes
			endif
			if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
				if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 30 ) ; player beat Mudalius in a nine-holes game
					Forcegreeting 
					return
				endif
			endif
		endif
		if ( isDead )
			set PC_m1_StrokeFort_BeatUp to 1
			Journal PC_m1_Anv_StrokeFort 50
			AddItem ""PC_m1_Anv_StrokeFort_Amulet"" 1 ; prevents pickpocketing
			""PC_m1_Lillal""->ModDisposition -30
			""PC_m1_Rutagio""->ModDisposition -30
			""PC_m1_PlociusZelus""->ModDisposition -30
			""PC_m1_Nura""->ModDisposition -30
			""PC_m1_PleaRufinus""->ModDisposition -30
			""PC_m1_NaHarra""->ModDisposition -30
		elseif ( GetHealthGetRatio < 0.2 )
			set PC_m1_StrokeFort_BeatUp to 1
			StopCombat
			SetFight 30
			""PC_m1_Lillal""->ModDisposition -20
			""PC_m1_Rutagio""->ModDisposition -20
			""PC_m1_PlociusZelus""->ModDisposition -20
			""PC_m1_Nura""->ModDisposition -20
			""PC_m1_PleaRufinus""->ModDisposition -20
			""PC_m1_NaHarra""->ModDisposition -20
			Forcegreeting
			return
		endif
	elseif ( T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes == 0 ) ; quest stakes are over, so sets assigned stakes back
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to tempStakes
	endif
endif

if ( PC_Map == 0 )
	set PC_Map to 1
endif

End$00"

 SCPT.SCTX "begin PC_m1_Pub_Abecette_sc

;Cell: Anvil, The Abecette: Hotel
;Publican: PC_m1_Lillal
;Flag: PC_m1_Rented_Abecette

;all rooms get rented for one day
;This guy must be in the map where the room is if you use the locked door cell loading cleanup
;rename the script for the guy and make a specific door to unlock or flag to set
;NO actual key is given to player, a global flag is set that removes the ownership on the beds.

;this script fires off when RENT is set true. Rent is set true through the BEDS topic in dialogue, which all Publicans have.
;Each publican will also have a separate response to buying the bed, so they can give simple directions. There is also a default one.

short rent				;if room is rented, set through dialogue on this NPC
short rentDay			;the day of the rental
short rentMonth		;the month of the rental
short setup				;if setup has been done
short cleanup			;true if you want to cleanup all the flags, rental is over and can be reset
short PC_Map
short control
short controlQ
short NoLore
short T_Local_NPC

;this script also uses a global variable (PC_m1_Rented_Abecette). Make a new one for each rental. You can have as many
;beds as you want use that variable, it is used through the ownership data on the object reference

if ( rent )
	if ( setup == 0 )
		set rentDay to Day
		set rentMonth to Month
		set setup to 1
		set PC_m1_Rented_Abecette to 1		;this is the flag for the ownership on the bed
		""PC_m1_Rent_Abecette""->unlock			;also needed if you have locked the room, use a specific objectRef
	else	;setup is done so check to see if the day is over
		if ( Day != rentDay )
			set cleanup to 1	
		elseif ( Month != rentMonth )
			set cleanup to 1
		endif
	endif

	if ( CellChanged )	;this is only needed if you've done a locked door. If so, you only want to do this on cell change so you don't lock them in the room
		if ( cleanup )		;this gets called when the rental is over and everything can be cleaned up
			set rent to 0
			set PC_m1_Rented_Abecette to 0
			set setup to 0
			set rentDay to 0
			set rentMonth to 0
			set cleanup to 0
			""PC_m1_Rent_Abecette""->lock 75
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( PC_Map == 0 )
	set PC_Map to 1
endif

end
$00"
-SCPT

 SCPT.SCTX "begin PC_m1_Pub_Caravan_sc

;Cell: Anvil, Caravan Stop
;Publican: PC_m1_EuthaMiterian
;Flag: PC_m1_Rented_Caravan

;all rooms get rented for one day
;This guy must be in the map where the room is if you use the locked door cell loading cleanup
;rename the script for the guy and make a specific door to unlock or flag to set
;NO actual key is given to player, a global flag is set that removes the ownership on the beds.

;this script fires off when RENT is set true. Rent is set true through the BEDS topic in dialogue, which all Publicans have.
;Each publican will also have a separate response to buying the bed, so they can give simple directions. There is also a default one.

short rent				;if room is rented, set through dialogue on this NPC
short rentDay			;the day of the rental
short rentMonth		;the month of the rental
short setup				;if setup has been done
short cleanup			;true if you want to cleanup all the flags, rental is over and can be reset
short PC_Map
short control
short controlQ
short NoLore
short T_Local_NPC

;this script also uses a global variable (PC_m1_Rented_Caravan). Make a new one for each rental. You can have as many
;beds as you want use that variable, it is used through the ownership data on the object reference


if ( rent )
	if ( setup == 0 )
		set rentDay to Day
		set rentMonth to Month
		set setup to 1
		set PC_m1_Rented_Caravan to 1		;this is the flag for the ownership on the bed
		""PC_m1_Rent_Caravan""->unlock			;also needed if you have locked the room, use a specific objectRef
	else	;setup is done so check to see if the day is over
		if ( Day != rentDay )
			set cleanup to 1	
		elseif ( Month != rentMonth )
			set cleanup to 1
		endif
	endif

	if ( CellChanged )	;this is only needed if you've done a locked door. If so, you only want to do this on cell change so you don't lock them in the room
		if ( cleanup )		;this gets called when the rental is over and everything can be cleaned up
			set rent to 0
			set PC_m1_Rented_Caravan to 0
			set setup to 0
			set rentDay to 0
			set rentMonth to 0
			set cleanup to 0
			""PC_m1_Rent_Caravan""->lock 75
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( PC_Map == 0 )
	set PC_Map to 1
endif

end

$00"
-SCPT

 SCPT.SCTX "begin PC_m1_Pub_Sunset_sc

;Cell: Charach, Sunset Hotel
;Publican: PC_m1_VarotiaClovas
;Flag: PC_m1_Rented_Sunset

;all rooms get rented for one day
;This guy must be in the map where the room is if you use the locked door cell loading cleanup
;rename the script for the guy and make a specific door to unlock or flag to set
;NO actual key is given to player, a global flag is set that removes the ownership on the beds.

;this script fires off when RENT is set true. Rent is set true through the BEDS topic in dialogue, which all Publicans have.
;Each publican will also have a separate response to buying the bed, so they can give simple directions. There is also a default one.

short rent				;if room is rented, set through dialogue on this NPC
short rentDay			;the day of the rental
short rentMonth		;the month of the rental
short setup				;if setup has been done
short cleanup			;true if you want to cleanup all the flags, rental is over and can be reset
short PC_Map
short control
short controlQ
short NoLore
short T_Local_NPC

;this script also uses a global variable (PC_m1_Rented_Sunset). Make a new one for each rental. You can have as many
;beds as you want use that variable, it is used through the ownership data on the object reference

if ( rent )
	if ( setup == 0 )
		set rentDay to Day
		set rentMonth to Month
		set setup to 1
		set PC_m1_Rented_Sunset to 1		;this is the flag for the ownership on the bed
		""PC_m1_Rent_Sunset""->unlock			;also needed if you have locked the room, use a specific objectRef
	else	;setup is done so check to see if the day is over
		if ( Day != rentDay )
			set cleanup to 1	
		elseif ( Month != rentMonth )
			set cleanup to 1
		endif
	endif

	if ( CellChanged )	;this is only needed if you've done a locked door. If so, you only want to do this on cell change so you don't lock them in the room
		if ( cleanup )		;this gets called when the rental is over and everything can be cleaned up
			set rent to 0
			set PC_m1_Rented_Sunset to 0
			set setup to 0
			set rentDay to 0
			set rentMonth to 0
			set cleanup to 0
			""PC_m1_Rent_Sunset""->lock 75
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( PC_Map == 0 )
	set PC_Map to 1
endif

end

$00"

 SCPT.SCTX "Begin PC_m1_RueVaneria_sc

;Local script on NPC PC_m1_RueVaneria
;Anvil bounty quest PC_m1_Anv_Bounty_Rue

;controlQ = 0 = nothing
;controlQ = 1 = player told Rue about bounty
;controlQ = 2 = NPC aggroed
;controlQ = 3 = NPC yielded to player
;controlQ = 4 = Player let Rue go

short PC_Map
short T_Local_NoLore
short NoLore
short T_Local_NPC
short control
short controlQ

;Update journal if NPC is killed before being captured, but only if the PC has started the quest
if ( OnDeath )
	if ( GetJournalIndex PC_m1_Anv_Bounty_Rue < 90 )
		if ( controlQ > 0 ) ;a player could theoretically get to this point without receiving a journal update
			Journal PC_m1_Anv_Bounty_Rue 90
		elseif ( GetJournalIndex PC_m1_Anv_Bounty_Rue > 0 )
			Journal PC_m1_Anv_Bounty_Rue 90
		endif
	endif
endif

;Disable Rue upon cell change if the player lets her go
if ( controlQ == 4 )
	if ( CellChanged == 1 )
		Disable
	endif
endif

;Force NPC to follow player if nearly killed
if ( controlQ > 0 ) ;Rue won't agree to be taken to Goldstone if you haven't told her about the bounty
	if ( GetJournalIndex PC_m1_Anv_Bounty_Rue < 30 )
    	if ( control > 0 )
    	elseif ( OnKnockout )
        	set control to 1
    	elseif ( GetHealth < 30 )
        	set control to 1
    	endif
	endif
endif

if ( control == 1 )
    SetFight 30
    StopCombat
    set control to 2
    set controlQ to 3
    AiFollow Player 0 0 0 0
    ForceGreeting
endif

;If this fires then the player has led the NPC to Faviana Taucita in Goldstone: Grand Foyer
if ( GetPCCell ""Goldstone, Grand Foyer"" )
	if ( GetDistance ""PC_m1_FavianaTaucita"" <= 512 )
    	if ( GetJournalIndex ""PC_m1_Anv_Bounty_Rue"" < 50 )
        	SetFight 30
        	StopCombat
			SetHello 0
        	AIWander 0 0 0 100 0 0 0 0 0 0 0 0
			set PC_m1_Anv_Bounty_RueCaptured to 1
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( PC_Map == 0 )
	set PC_Map to 1
endif

End$00"

	if ( GetDistance ""PC_m1_FavianaTaucita"" <= 512 )
    	if ( GetJournalIndex ""PC_m1_Anv_Bounty_Rycima"" < 30 )
        	SetFight 30
        	StopCombat

		endif
	endif

	if ( GetJournalIndex PC_m1_Anv_Bounty_Rycima >= 30 )
		PC_m1_Rycima->Disable
	endif
endif

if ( OnDeath )
	if ( GetJournalIndex PC_m1_Anv_Bounty_Rycima > 0 )
		Journal PC_m1_Anv_Bounty_Rycima 60
	endif
endif

if ( PC_Map == 0 )
	set PC_Map to 1
endif

 SCPT.SCTX "Begin PC_m1_SKarra_sc
; This short script allows dialogue to filtered by county. 
; This is the NoLore version
; Anvil=0 Kvatch=1 Skingrad=2 Chorrol=3 Bruma=4 Cheydinhal=5 
; Bravil=6 Leyawiin=7 Imperial City=8

short PC_Map
short T_Local_NoLore
short control
short controlQ
short NoLore
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_Khajiit

short isExpelledIP ; dialogue filter variable to check if PC is expelled from IP faction
short hasPaintingSupplies ; dialogue filter variable to check if PC has S'Karra's painting supplies

if ( CellChanged )
	set isExpelledIP to ( PCExpelled ""T_Cyr_ItinerantPriests"" )
endif

; This script is used for Luaki's IP Quest 2

if ( GetJournalIndex ""PC_m1_IP_Lki2"" == 30 )
	; checks if player brought all nine painting supplies
	if ( player->GetItemCount ""T_Com_Paint_Palette_01"" >= 1 )
		if ( player->GetItemCount ""T_Com_Paintbrush_04B"" >= 1 )
			if ( player->GetItemCount ""T_Com_Paintbrush_04G"" >= 1 )
				if ( player->GetItemCount ""T_Com_Paintbrush_04R"" >= 1 )
					if ( player->GetItemCount ""T_Com_Paintbrush_04Y"" >= 1 )
						if ( player->GetItemCount ""T_Com_PaintpotB_01"" >= 1 )
							if ( player->GetItemCount ""T_Com_PaintpotG_01"" >= 1 )
								if ( player->GetItemCount ""T_Com_PaintpotR_01"" >= 1 )
									if ( player->GetItemCount ""T_Com_PaintpotY_01"" >= 1 )
										set hasPaintingSupplies to 1
									else
										set hasPaintingSupplies to 0
									endif
								else
									set hasPaintingSupplies to 0
								endif
							else
								set hasPaintingSupplies to 0
							endif
						else
							set hasPaintingSupplies to 0
						endif
					else
						set hasPaintingSupplies to 0
					endif
				else
					set hasPaintingSupplies to 0
				endif
			else
				set hasPaintingSupplies to 0
			endif
		else
			set hasPaintingSupplies to 0
		endif
	else
		set hasPaintingSupplies to 0
	endif
endif

; This script is for general Khajiit dialogue filtering

if ( T_Local_Khajiit )
	return
endif

set T_Local_Khajiit to -1

if ( GetRace ""T_Els_Cathay"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Cathay-raht"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Dagi-raht"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Ohmes"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Ohmes-raht"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""T_Els_Suthay"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace ""Khajiit"" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
endif

set PC_Map to 1

End
$00"

	;lootable if dead

	if ( GetDeadCount ""PC_m1_Sal"" > 0 )
		Activate
		return
	elseif ( GetJournalIndex PC_m1_Anv_FeedSal == 10 )
   	set MessageOn to 1
	endif

	return

	MessageBox ""麝鼠期待地看着你。要喂她吗？"" ""是"" ""否""

	set Button to GetButtonPressed

	if ( Button == -1 ) ; Nothing
   	return
   endif

	if ( Button == 0 )  ; Yes
     	if ( player->GetItemCount T_IngFlor_Cabbage_01 >= 1 )
			if ( player->GetItemCount T_IngFood_MeatArenthJerky_01 >=1 )
         	player->RemoveItem T_IngFlor_Cabbage_01 1
				player->RemoveItem T_IngFood_MeatArenthJerky_01 1

				Set MessageOn to 0
				playsound ""rat moan""
				MessageBox ""萨尔从你手里抢过食物，开始凶猛地啃咬起来。她发出快乐的哼哼声。"" ""好的""
         	return
			else
				Set MessageOn to 0
				MessageBox ""你缺少喂萨尔所需的食物。"" ""好的""
				return
			endif
		else 
			Set MessageOn to 0
			MessageBox ""你缺少喂萨尔所需的食物。"" ""好的""
			return
		endif
	elseif ( Button == 1 )      ; No
		Set MessageOn to 0
	endif
endif

short T_Local_Nolore
float timer

; Sielle's script - this controls her movement (recalling to the basement for Q3 and Q4 and then back to her original spot at the end of the chain)
; Controls her animations for casting the experiments and recall
; Controls her collapsing during Q3
; Handling for Q3 so that the player can't activate her while she is collapsed
; Handling so the player can't activate her during any of her animations
if ( menumode == 1 )
	return
endif

if ( getjournalindex PC_m1_MG_BC3 == 10 ) 
	if ( state == 0 )
		cast dispel ""PC_m1_SielleEumand"" ; cast dispel for the animation - looks like a recall
		set state to 1
	endif
	if ( state == 1 )
		set timer to ( timer + getsecondspassed )
		if ( timer > 2 )
			disable
			positioncell 3670 3690 3750 22000 ""brina cross, guild of mages"" ; move her to basement for Q3 and Q4
			enable
			aiwander 0 0 0 60 20 10 0 0 0 0 0
			face 3782 3661
			set timer to 0
			set state to 2
		endif
	endif
elseif ( getjournalindex PC_m1_MG_BC3 == 20 )
	if ( state == 2 )
		""PC_m1_JarvunCrowSight""->SetHello 0 ; prevents oddity where javrun runs over and says an out of place hello line
		face 3782 3661 ; Note: this is manually necessary so she falls the same way in OpenMW a Vanilla - doesn't actually change her facing for the animation
		cast ""dispel"" ""PC_m1_SielleEumand"" ; cast for the animation
		set state to 3
	endif
	if ( state == 3 )
		set timer to ( timer + getsecondspassed )
		if ( timer > 2 )
			setfatigue 0 ; she collapses
			setalarm 0
			journal PC_m1_MG_BC3 30
			set state to 4
			set timer to 0
			""PC_m1_JarvunCrowSight""->Forcerun
			""PC_m1_JarvunCrowSight""->aitravel 3861 3728 3745 ; force Jarvun to run over in concern
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( state == 4 )
	if ( controlQ == 0 )
		set timer to ( timer + getsecondspassed )
		if ( timer > 2 )
			set controlQ to 1
			if ( player->getdistance ""PC_m1_JarvunCrowSight"" <= 300 )
				if ( GetDeadCount ""PC_m1_JarvunCrowSight"" == 0 )
					""PC_m1_JarvunCrowSight""->Forcegreeting ; Forcegreet as long as pc hasn't fled
				endif
			endif
		endif
	else
		set timer to 0
	endif		
endif

if ( getjournalindex PC_m1_MG_BC3 == 50 )
	set state to 5
	if ( PC_Control1 == 0 )
		setfatigue 261 ; wakes back up at appropriate quest stage
		setalarm 100
		positioncell 3664 3625 3750 22000 ""brina cross, guild of mages"" ; so if she falls differently in different engines (she does) she goes back to a spot that makes sene
		aiwander 0 0 0 60 20 10 0 0 0 0 0
		face 3782 3661
		set PC_Control1 to 1
	endif
elseif ( getjournalindex PC_m1_MG_BC3 == 100 )
	if ( PC_Control2 == 0 )
		""PC_m1_JarvunCrowSight""->ClearForcerun
		""PC_m1_JarvunCrowSight""->aitravel 4178 3792 3745 ; when done move him back
		""PC_m1_JarvunCrowSight""->SetHello 30 ; puts his hello lines back to normal
		set PC_Control2 to 1
	endif
endif

if ( getjournalindex PC_m1_MG_BC4 == 80 )
	if ( PC_ControlA == 0 )
		face 3782 3661 ; not sure this matters but trying to make sure she faces the ring
		cast ""dispel"" ""PC_m1_SielleEumand""  ; dispel animation for 2nd experiment
		set PC_ControlA to 1
	endif
	if ( PC_ControlA == 1 )
		set timer to ( timer + getsecondspassed )
		if ( timer > 4 )
			if ( getdistance player <= 300 )
				forcegreeting
			endif
			set PC_ControlA to 2
			set timer to 0
		endif
	endif
elseif ( getjournalindex PC_m1_MG_BC4 == 100 )
	if ( PC_Control3 == 0 )
		cast dispel ""PC_m1_SielleEumand"" ; dispel for the animation
		set PC_Control3 to 1
	endif
	if ( PC_Control3 == 1 )
		set timer to ( timer + getsecondspassed )
		if ( timer > 2 )
			disable
			positioncell 3949 3984 4787 0 ""brina cross, guild of mages"" ; end of quest move her back to top of MG
			enable
			aiwander 0 0 0 60 20 10 0 0 0 0 0
			set timer to 0
			set PC_Control3 to 2
			set state to 10
		endif
	endif
endif
			
if ( OnActivate ) ; This is to prevent activating Sielle during her animations OR when she is collapsed
	if ( PC_Control3 == 1 )
		return
	elseif ( PC_ControlA == 1 )
		return
	elseif ( state == 1 )
		return
	elseif ( state == 3 )
		return
	elseif ( state == 4 )
		Messagebox ""西埃尔还有呼吸，但没有反应。""
	else
		Activate
	endif
endif

if ( PC_Map == 0 )
	set PC_Map to 1
endif

End

 SCPT.SCTX "Begin PC_m1_SolvusOrrich_sc
;This script makes Solvus Orrich ForceGreet the player and possibly Akaterina Hadrach during Herrius Thimistrel's fifth Kingdom of Anvil quest, beginning his boss fight.
;It has a slight delay because making him ForceGreet immediately upon CellChanged caused some issues for me during the fight.

short PC_Map
short T_Local_NoLore
short control
short controlQ
short NoLore
short T_Local_NPC
short ShouldForceGreet
float TimePassed

if ( ShouldForceGreet == 1 )
	Set TimePassed to ( TimePassed + GetSecondsPassed )
	if ( TimePassed >= 0.5 )
		Set TimePassed to 0
		Set ShouldForceGreet to 0
		if ( GetHealth > 0 )
			ForceGreeting
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( PC_m1_K1_HT_HighAlert == 1 )
	if ( CellChanged == 1 )
		if ( controlQ == 0 )
			set ShouldForceGreet to 1
		endif
		if ( GetJournalIndex ""PC_m1_K1_HT5"" > 0 )
			if ( GetDeadCount ""PC_m1_AkaterinaHadrach"" == 0 )
				""PC_m1_AkaterinaHadrach""->PositionCell 3773 4156 11812 8580 ""Goldstone, Great Hall"" ;In case the player made her wait somewhere
				""PC_m1_AkaterinaHadrach""->AIWander 0 0 0 60 20 10
				Set ""PC_m1_AkaterinaHadrach"".control to 5
				Set controlQ to 1
			else
				Set controlQ to 2
			endif
		else
			Set controlQ to 2
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( OnDeath == 1 )
	Set ""PC_m1_K1_HT5_GuardDead"" to ( ""PC_m1_K1_HT5_GuardDead"" + 1 )
endif

if ( PC_Map == 0 )
	set PC_Map to 1
endif

End
$00"

 SCPT.SCTX "Begin PC_m1_TG_Anv7_NewsSpawner_sc

short doOnce

; This script spawns one of the three possible TG7 articles of the Abecean Monitor
; depending on the value of the PC_m1_TG_Anv7_Outcome global variable

if ( CellChanged == 1 )
	if ( PC_m1_TG_Anv7_Outcome == 1 )
		PlaceAtMe T_News_AbMonitor_26 1 0 1
		set doOnce to 40
	elseif ( PC_m1_TG_Anv7_Outcome == 2 )
		PlaceAtMe T_News_AbMonitor_25 1 0 1
		set doOnce to 40
	elseif ( PC_m1_TG_Anv7_Outcome == 3 )
		PlaceAtMe T_News_AbMonitor_24 1 0 1
		set doOnce to 40
	endif
	if ( GetDisabled == 0 ) ; Hide the spawner
		Disable
	endif
endif

if ( doOnce == 40 )
	SetDelete 1 ; Remove the spawner
	return
endif

End$00"

 SCPT.SCTX "begin PC_m1_TorioTulanus_sc

; Script to set magic effect on Torio during the first Brina Cross Mages Guild
short PC_Map
short control
short controlQ
short state
short NoLore
short T_Local_NPC
short nofight
short nothief

if ( state == 3 ) ; after cured short circuit script
	return
endif

If ( Cellchanged ) ; ONLY run the paralysis script on cellchange so it only runs once
	if ( state <= 1 ) ; Make sure state is 0 or 1, prevents odd edge case of player curing, leaving shop and then returning before moving the quest forward and Torio re-paralyzing
		if ( getjournalindex PC_m1_MG_BC1 < 10 ) ; BEFORE the quest short circuit
			if ( nofight != 1 )
				set nofight to 1
				set nothief to 1
			endif
			return
		elseif ( getjournalindex PC_m1_MG_BC1 == 10 ) ; Paraylze Torio if player ON quest
			setparalysis 1
			sethello 0 ; don't want any greetings playing while paralyzed
			set state to 1
			set nofight to 0
			set nothief to 0
		else ; If player has seen torio on the quest, but couldn't cure him and still completed quest cure Torio on next cellchange
			setparalysis 0
			sethello 30 ; add back in greetings
			set state to 3
			set nofight to 1
			set nothief to 1
		endif
	endif
endif
		
If ( state == 1 ) ; Only check for dispel if paralysis script has run
	if ( getjournalindex PC_m1_MG_BC1 == 10 ) ; Only check for dispel if on the correct quest stage, mostly redundant
		if ( GetEffect sEffectDispel == 1 ) ; If player dispells remove and set state to 2 for dialogue
			setparalysis 0
			sethello 30 ; add back in greetings
			set state to 2
			set nofight to 1
			set nothief to 1
		elseif ( Geteffect sEffectCureParalyzation == 1 ) ; also if player cast cure paralysis
			setparalysis 0
			sethello 30 ; add back in greetings
			set state to 2
			set nofight to 1
			set nothief to 1
		endif	
	endif
endif

if ( PC_Map == 0 )
	set PC_Map to 1
endif

end
$00"

	if ( GetDisabled )

		disable

		ForceGreeting
	endif

		StopCombat

	endif

	StartScript PC_m1_IP_Als4_Move_sc

健忘之人的芦荟疗法
<BR>
<DIV ALIGN=""LEFT""><BR><BR>
如果有人来找我，说是中毒了，我会用芦荟果肉和一把人参片调成混合物。喝上一口这种解药，即使被哥布林毒刺刺中也能救你一命。我自己就遇到过两次。
<BR>
当渔夫们来找我，咒骂不得不在没有星光的夜晚工作的命运时，我会给他们提供以下配方。我把三片斗篷草叶子切碎，与两把芦荟果肉混合。将此混合物在水中煮沸五分钟，便能得到一瓶夜视药水。但由于斗篷草不易获得，我经常牺牲储藏室的一根胡萝卜来达到同样的效果。
<BR>
最后，当有人容易生病时，比如我们尊敬的管事，我会建议他们服用以下药剂。用研钵和杵捣碎两瓣大蒜，加入一勺芦荟。用热水混合，静置几分钟以达到理想状态。之后，给体弱多病者服用，以增强对疾病的抵抗力。我注意到这种药剂的另一个显著效果是，它能让他们的懒惰暂时消失。对于我们村的领导层来说，这是一种无可替代的疗法。

[这本笔记本里有长达数周的记录，页边空白处潦草地写满了亚历德语和各种小笔记，这些笔记要么是糟糕的笔迹，要么是学者的个人密码。]<BR>
<BR>
.......在这座古老城堡的厅室中搜寻数日后，我欣喜若狂地发现了加拉斯·阿格亚的大图书馆。哦，它确实宏大无比！我知道我是数千年来第一个目睹这些神圣厅堂的人，也许是有史以来第一个不受束缚的人。我开始研读一卷又一卷僵硬、易碎的卷轴，描摹一幅又一幅褪色、腐蚀的蚀刻版画。现在，距离我最后一次见到太阳，想必已有数周之久了。留给我的只有这冰冷、人造的星光。<BR>
<BR>
进入图书馆后，我发现了一扇石门，与这片废墟中的许多其他门不同，它对我收集到的任何拱心石都没有反应，蛮力也无法打开。起初我以为只是没找到对应的拱心石，决定稍后再回来，先专注于收集这座图书馆所提供的知识。然而，我在图书馆中的发现引出了一个迷人的结论：这扇门需要用咒语开启，但经过数周的研究，我未能找到它。当我意识到口粮耗尽时，我离开了，对记录在这本日志中的发现感到欣喜若狂，但同时也因未能发现这扇门的秘密而闷闷不乐。<BR>
<BR>
随后我发现，不知通过何种神秘方式，我进来时经过的那扇门被完全封死了。它，就像下面一层那扇门一样，现在对我的触碰和我的钥匙都不再有任何反应。我怀疑这是游荡在这座城堡中的众多守护之灵所为，它们只是按部就班地执行着自己的习性，丝毫没有意识到里面还有一个它不知道的凡人存在。数日之后，我只好听天由命，等待死亡。<BR>
<BR>
然而，我不愿让我的死亡毫无意义。我将这最后一条记录献给你，无论你是谁，发现了这本笔记本。我临终的愿望是将其出版，让这个世界知晓我在这个受诅咒的图书馆中的所有发现。我在饥饿中度过了最后的时日，阅读着越来越多的文本，并将它们记录在这本日志中。<BR>
<BR>
然后，我看到了希望：我找到了打开那扇门的咒语。我欣喜若狂地冲向那扇门，张开嘴，准备大声念出咒语。<BR>
<BR>
从嘴里出来的只有尘土。我虚弱得说不出话来。该死的。<BR>
<BR>
我只能希望发现此物的你有意志念出这句咒语。我将其记录如下。<BR>
<DIV ALIGN=""CENTER""><BR><BR>
VA GARLAS AGEA GRAVIA YE GORIA LATTA MALLARI AV MALATU<BR>
<BR>
在学识的洞穴中，丑陋而晦暗，真理之金闪耀其间。<BR>

亲爱的塞尔迪娅：
<BR>
我真心希望此信送达时你一切安好。
<BR>
这是我试图寄给你的第六封后续信件，还不包括我之前按常规寄出的那两封毫无回音的信件。我已经不再认为这是不幸的巧合，并且毫无疑问地知道，你一定是被某种方式阻止而无法回信。我只能希望我的信依然能送到你手中。
<BR>

<BR>

<BR>
不言而喻，我非常期待你的康复和回信。我深切地感受到了缺少你书信往来的日子，但这只是能来帮助你让我如此高兴的部分原因。另一部分原因是，我知道你也会为我这样做。
<BR>
<BR>
你的朋友，
<BR>
比娅
